C0466.title: Photo-Editing Trickery: Man in Qinzhou Scams Pawnshops Three Times with Fake Transfer Screenshots
C0466.summary: In March 2024, a man surnamed Lin in Qinzhou used photo-editing software to alter the amounts and times on transfer screenshots, deceiving pawnshops and other merchants into trusting the fake payment records. He succeeded in scamming them three times in a row.

references.title: Case Explanation: Why Did the 'Fake Screenshot' Scam Keep Working? The Truth Was Simple
